paper.title: Mask R-CNN R-50-FPN on COCO (Section 4, 160k iterations)

note: Paper: 8 GPUs x 2 images, LR 0.02 decayed by 10 at 120k of 160k iterations, momentum 0.9, wd 1e-4, images resized to 800 px shorter side, ImageNet-pretrained backbone; trainval35k / minival. Warmup is a later Detectron convention. Requires a COCO loader and pycocotools for AP; the train loop uses synthetic shapes. RoIAlign uses the aligned=True convention by default; set aligned=False to match the original Detectron.
